Standing in turquoise shallows off the north beach, looking east along the coast. Left half: open deep-blue sea to the horizon. Right half: a long pale-sand beach curving away into the distance with palm trees behind it; further along the shore, the red extractor and its pipe scaffold reaching into the sea. Far right: green forest canopy rising inland.

On the sand of a long beach, looking west along the shoreline. Centre and right: the sea, turquoise near the shore and deep blue beyond; on the far-right horizon, Pleasure Island. Left midground: the red extractor and its pipe scaffold out over the shallows, palm trees and a driftwood log on the sand. Left edge: green meadow inland.

A grassy meadow looking north. Centre midground: Sylvie's cottage inside a low wooden picket fence, a small garden and a few giant mushrooms in front, pine trees either side. Behind it a pale beach, then the sea; on the horizon centre-left, Pleasure Island. Foreground: open grass and a round green bush.

At the western edge of a dense forest, looking east into it. Left: a sandy path and the red extractor's roof toward the beach. Centre and right: a thick canopy of rounded deciduous and pine trees stretching away, giant red-capped and blue mushrooms between the trunks, the ground rising gently toward the central plateau. Far right: grey stone ruins above the treeline.

Looking down into a sunken swamp: dark still pools with lily pads and cattails, divided by raised grassy banks with crumbling stone ledges, gnarled dark swamp trees and a dead red tree, a wooden chest on a small islet. Beyond, the land ends in low cliffs; on the far-left horizon across the sea, the glacier island.

On a high stone plateau, looking north at Veres' mesa rising straight ahead: a dark cave mouth at its base, a wooden ladder up its side, a small campfire nearby. Left and right: lavender-grey stone terraces and pine trees. Far beyond, the forest falls away to the north coast and the sea, with Pleasure Island on the far-left horizon.

A southern lowland meadow, looking east. Left: the land climbs in the central plateau's terraced cliffs, topped with pine forest. Centre: rolling green meadow with scattered boulders running toward the coast. Right: low cliffs drop to the sea; across the water, the glacier island.

On a high rocky hillside at the south edge of the main island, looking south over the sea. Foreground: lavender-grey rock and sparse grass falling away. Midground: across a channel of turquoise water, a snow-covered island with blue ice cliffs and a frozen pool ringed by ice. Far right: more of the glacier coast.

Mountain forest on the western slopes of the central plateau, looking southeast. Foreground: lavender-grey stone terraces, carved stone stairs leading down, purple-leaved shrubs. Midground: pine trees and grassy ledges stepping down. Far: the sea, and the glacier island on the horizon.

Out on open sea in a violent storm, looking northwest. Huge dark waves in the foreground. Midground: Pleasure Island, its cliffs lashed by surf, a rowing boat tied at its foot. Dark storm clouds, lightning, sheets of rain.
Open sea looking north. Centre-right midground: the black-sailed galleon at anchor; to its right, a tiny sandy islet with a palm tree. Calm deep-blue water, a distant horizon.

On a clifftop path along the southern coast, looking east. Left: green coastal meadow with a dead red tree; inland, the terraced cliffs of the central plateau. Right: the cliff edge drops to a channel of sea; across it, the towering white wall of the glacier island.

At the foot of the glacier, looking north up its terraces: walls of pale blue ice cliffs, snowfields with dark stone obelisks and a bare dead tree, small purple frost flowers. Far: the green main island across the sea.

On the glacier summit, looking north. Foreground: a frozen moat ringed with ice crystals around a small snowy islet with a golden ankh-shaped shrine. Beyond the glacier's ice-cliff edge and across a channel: the green main island, its swamp, meadows and the central plateau.

From the sea off the glacier island's south coast, looking north at it: jagged blue ice cliffs rising from turquoise water, snowfields above with dark stone pillars, and a camp with a campfire and wooden barricades at the mouth of an ice cave.
Turquoise shallows dotted with small flat sandbar islets: one with a single tall orange sunflower, another with a campfire. Calm clear water, open-sea horizon.

From the water, looking at a tiny deserted island: pale sand, two red-leaved palm trees, a large wooden treasure chest. The black-sailed galleon anchored to its left, the white-sailed ship to its right.

Upper mountain forest by a river, looking southwest. Foreground: thick pine canopy. Midground: a blue river pool with lily pads winding between grassy banks, lavender-grey rock, a stone pillar. Far: across the sea, the glacier island.

Looking north across the grounds of the ruined dragon shrine: crumbling grey stone walls with arched windows, broken pillars, stone dragon statues flanking a golden ankh, a ruined stone building with a blue tiled roof on the right, ivy and red flowers everywhere. Beyond, forest and the northern sea.

From the sea east of the main island, looking west at its eastern cliffs: tall lavender-grey rock faces, a waterfall pouring from the cliff into the sea, pine forest on top. To the left, the south coast and a glimpse of the glacier island.

At the foot of a waterfall in mountain forest, looking north: a wide waterfall dropping over lavender-grey cliffs into a pool, a winding blue river above with lily pads, pines along the ledges, and the ruined shrine's stone building visible on the right-hand ledge.

Close to a frozen spring on a small ice island, looking north: a still pool of turquoise water ringed by ice crystals in the foreground, snowfields and small purple frost plants around it. Across a channel, the main island's south cliffs, green on top.

Open sea looking west at the main island's east coast: low grassy cliffs, the ruined shrine with grey stone walls and a blue-roofed building, forest and a river behind it, the central plateau rising in the middle distance.

On a high snowy plateau of the glacier island, looking east: an open snowfield, dark stone pillars and fallen columns, ice ridges and blue ice cliffs dropping toward the sea on the left; the green main island on the horizon.
Snowy slopes of the glacier island, looking north: terraced snowfields, blue ice cliffs, dark stone pillars lining a path, ice boulders, a lit torch. Far: the sea and the main island.
On cold, choppy turquoise water between islands, looking south. Right: the towering ice cliffs of the glacier island. Left: distant sandbar islets. Pale overcast sky.
Open sea looking southwest: a cluster of flat sandbars in turquoise shallows in the midground, and the white edge of the glacier island on the far right.

On a small ice island, looking north from its southern snowfield: a rim of blue ice cliffs and drifts in the foreground, frost plants. Across a channel, the long south coast of the main island: lavender-grey cliffs with green grass on top.

On Pleasure Island, looking east across its plateau: grass with a red-earth clearing, red palm trees, flaming stone torches, cliff edges dropping away on both sides. Across the water on the right, the long north beach of the main island.
On the north-east headland, looking northwest: a grassy coast with the commanders' red canvas tent and a stone well, the forest edge on the left. Beyond, the sea with two ships and a sandy islet.
